blocks.section: USE OF THE INFUSION SYSTEM IN ELECTROMAGNETIC ENVIRONMENTS
blocks.content: The Plum A+ ®  infusion system (outside of the United States) is intended for use in  the  electromagnetic  environment  specified  in Electromagnetic  Emissions, Electromagnetic Immunity, and Electromagnetic Immunity for Life-Supporting Equipment and Systems . The user of the infusion system should assure that it is used only in the appropriate environment. EN-2
